Rule.name: Logon Time Outside Business Hours
Rule.description: Fires when a successful interactive logon occurs outside the configured business window (default 08:00-18:00 local). Use eventType = Win-Security-4624 and filter on logonType in (2, 10).

Rule.name: Failed Logon Burst
Rule.description: Multiple failed logons from the same source IP within 5 minutes.

Rule.name: VPN Session Established
Rule.description: Successful VPN tunnel establishment for remote workforce.
